findings.title: Delete is never shown on Grafana rows in the list view
findings.body: `canDelete` is computed from the Grafana ability (lines 85-87), but the menu item also requires `rulerRule` (line 165). List rows now render `RuleActionsButtons.V2` with only `promRule` (GrafanaRuleListItem.tsx:47), so `rulerRule` is undefined and Delete never renders, even for users with AlertingRuleDelete. Before this PR the list passed the ruler rule (the removed GrafanaRuleLoader.tsx), so Delete showed. The list-row delete handler does not need the ruler rule: RuleActionsButtons.V2.tsx:99 calls `showDeleteModal(identifier, groupIdentifier)` and ignores its argument. Fix: show the item on `canDelete` alone and loosen the `handleDelete` type so it does not require a RulerRuleDTO. I only confirmed the two RuleActionsButtons callers of AlertRuleMenu.
findings.originReason: The base list item passed the ruler rule to RuleActionsButtons. This diff removed it, so the `rulerRule` gate now always fails.

verification.reason: List rows now pass only `promRule` to RuleActionsButtons.V2, so `rule`/`rulerRule` is undefined, and the Delete item is gated on `canDelete && rulerRule`. Delete therefore never renders. Before this change the list passed `rule={rulerRule}`.

findings.title: Pause/Resume is never shown on Grafana rows in the list view
findings.body: `canPause` is computed from the Grafana ability (line 83), but the item is gated on `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)` (line 123). `MenuItemPauseRule` requires a `RulerGrafanaRuleDTO` (MenuItemPauseRule.tsx:9-12) and reads `grafana_alert.is_paused` and `grafana_alert.uid` (MenuItemPauseRule.tsx:28, 37, 52). List rows therefore lose Pause/Resume, which they had before this PR. The sibling also refetches rules after a pause via `onPauseChange` (RuleActionsButtons.tsx:123-131), and the V2 component does not pass it. A fix needs MenuItemPauseRule to accept the prom-side uid and isPaused, plus a refresh of the Prometheus group query. Changing the condition alone is not enough.
findings.originReason: Base list rows passed the ruler rule, so Pause rendered. The diff removed that.

verification.reason: `canPause` can now come from the prom ability, but MenuItemPauseRule renders only when `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)` holds. That is never true for list rows, which supply only `promRule`.

findings.title: Silence notifications does nothing on Grafana rows in the list view
findings.body: The 'Silence notifications' item is now shown on list rows: `canSilence` comes from the Grafana ability (AlertRuleMenu.tsx:96, useAbilities.ts:323). Clicking it calls `setShowSilenceDrawer(true)` (V2.tsx:100), but the drawer renders only when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` holds (line 104). `rule` is undefined on list rows, so the click shows no drawer and no error. The sibling renders the drawer from `rule.rulerRule` (RuleActionsButtons.tsx:135-137). Fix: render the drawer from the prom rule, or hide the item unless the drawer can open. Check what SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer reads from `rulerRule` before choosing.
findings.originReason: Before this change, list rows supplied `rule={rulerRule}`, so the drawer could open.

verification.reason: For list rows, `canSilence` is true via the Grafana prom ability, so the Silence item shows. The drawer, however, renders only when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` holds, and `rule` is undefined, so clicking the item does nothing.

findings.title: Federated rule groups lose the immutable check on the CombinedRule path
findings.body: The deprecated `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` used to compute `isFederated = isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)`; that line is removed in this diff. The function now delegates to `useAllRulerRuleAbilities`, which hard-codes `const isFederated = false` (line 245). Federated Mimir groups therefore stop being immutable: Update, Delete and Pause become supported whenever the user has ruler permission. The rest of the UI hides editing for federated groups (RulesGroup.tsx:61,69; RuleDetailsButtons.tsx:38,42) and shows FederatedRuleWarning (RuleViewer.tsx:101,133). Callers that reach this path include RuleActionsButtons.tsx:57 and RuleViewer.tsx:126. useAbilities.test.tsx has no federated case, so nothing catches this. Fix: pass the group's federation state into the shared ability computation, e.g. from `isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)` in useAllAlertRuleAbilities.
findings.originReason: The base computed federation from `rule.group`. The diff replaced that with a delegation that hard-codes false.

verification.reason: Base `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` computed `isFederated = isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)`. It now delegates to `useAllRulerRuleAbilities`, which hard-codes `isFederated = false`, and `useIsRuleEditable` has no federation check, so federated groups are no longer immutable on the CombinedRule path.

findings.title: Grafana rule view link drops returnTo, so Back leaves the filtered list
findings.body: The href is now `createRelativeUrl(`/alerting/grafana/${uid}/view`)` (line 40). The removed GrafanaRuleLoader built it with `{ returnTo }`, and DataSourceRuleListItem still does (DataSourceRuleListItem.tsx:36,42). RuleViewer reads `useReturnTo('/alerting/list')` (RuleViewer.tsx:96) and renders the back button to that target (RuleViewer.tsx:300-304). From a filtered list, Back now lands on the unfiltered `/alerting/list`. Fix: `createRelativeUrl(..., { returnTo: createReturnTo() })`, with `createReturnTo` imported from '../hooks/useReturnTo'.
findings.originReason: The base href included `returnTo`. The new component dropped it.

verification.reason: The new href has no `returnTo`, while the base built it with `{ returnTo }`. RuleViewer falls back to '/alerting/list' when `returnTo` is missing.

findings.title: Grafana list item is rendered without a key
findings.body: The Grafana branch dropped `key`. The `key` destructured on line 152 is now used only by the other branches (lines 165, 169). React warns about the missing key and falls back to index identity. The list is append-only, so no wrong row appears today. But any reorder or removal would attach per-row state (silence drawer, delete modal) to the wrong rule. Fix: restore `key={key}`.

verification.reason: In the Grafana branch, GrafanaRuleListItem is returned from `map` without `key`, whereas the base GrafanaRuleLoader had `key={key}`.

findings.title: Menu test locks in the missing Delete and Pause actions
findings.body: The last test asserts exactly four menu items and never checks Delete, although it grants AlertingRuleDelete (lines 50 and 58) and defines `ui.menuItems.delete` (line 42) without using it. It passes only because of the Delete and Pause gaps (AlertRuleMenu.tsx:123, 165). Once those are fixed the count changes, so the test should assert each action explicitly, including Delete and Pause.

verification.reason: The test grants delete and update permissions, defines `ui.menuItems.delete` but never uses it, and asserts exactly 4 menu items. That count holds only because Delete and Pause are not rendered for prom-only rows.

findings.title: RulesTable tests never exercise the list-row path; the singular-hook mocks are no-ops
findings.body: The comment (lines 23-26) and the mocks set up singular `useRulerRuleAbility` and `useGrafanaPromRuleAbility` (lines 63-65, 85-87). RulesTable renders the non-V2 RuleActionsButtons (RulesTable.tsx:30, 329), which only calls `useAlertRuleAbility` (RuleActionsButtons.tsx:57), so the two singular mocks have no effect. Every case also passes a `rulerRule` (the Edit assertions need it, RuleActionsButtons.tsx:84). None exercises RuleActionsButtons.V2 with promRule only, which is where the Delete, Pause and Silence regressions occur. Consider a list-row test that asserts those items, and drop the unused mocks.

verification.reason: RulesTable uses the non-V2 RuleActionsButtons, which calls only `useAlertRuleAbility`; its AlertRuleMenu uses the plural hooks. No component under test calls `useRulerRuleAbility` or `useGrafanaPromRuleAbility`, so those mocks have no effect, and the V2 prom-only path is never exercised.

findings.title: Doc comment still says the loader reads Ruler endpoints
findings.body: The comment says the loader loads 'from Prometheus and Ruler endpoints' (line 25). It now queries only Prometheus (lines 34-41). Reword it.

verification.reason: The doc comment still says the loader reads 'Prometheus and Ruler endpoints', but the component now calls only `useGetGrafanaGroupsQuery`.

findings.title: Test name refers to a ruler rule that the component no longer reads
findings.body: 'should render rule with url when ruler and prom rule exist' describes a ruler lookup that no longer happens; the component reads only the Prometheus response. Rename it.

verification.reason: The test name still mentions a ruler rule, but GrafanaGroupLoader no longer reads ruler data; the test only sets prom rules.

findings.title: Stale comment and variable name after the ruler prefetch was removed
findings.body: The comment says 'preload ruler rules' and the variable on line 84 is `cacheAndRulerPreload`, but this diff removed the ruler prefetch. Reword the comment and rename the variable.

verification.reason: The comment mentions preloading ruler rules and the variable is named `cacheAndRulerPreload`, but the ruler prefetch was removed; only the prom cache upsert is left.

findings.title: useIsGrafanaPromRuleEditable duplicates the Grafana branch of useIsRuleEditable
findings.body: The '// duplicate' comment and `useIsGrafanaPromRuleEditable` (lines 349-378) repeat the Grafana-folder permission logic in hooks/useIsRuleEditable.ts:50-76 (not part of this review). Extract a shared helper or keep one copy so the two permission checks cannot drift.

verification.reason: `useIsGrafanaPromRuleEditable` repeats the Grafana-folder branch of `useIsRuleEditable`: `useFolder`, the no-folder fallback and `hasPermissionInMetadata` for update and delete.

findings.title: Were the Creating and Deleting rows dropped on purpose?
findings.body: The removed matchRules path showed 'Creating' rows for ruler-only rules and 'Deleting' rows for Prometheus-only rules, and its tests are deleted. The list now shows only Prometheus rules, so those states disappear and nothing replaces them. Was that intended? The PR body does not say.

verification.reason: The loader now maps only prom rules. The Creating rows (ruler-only rules) and the Deleting rows (`RuleOperationListItem` for prom-only rules) were removed with `matchRules`. Whether that was intended is a fair question.

contracts.action: Silence notifications from a list-row More menu
contracts.before_after: Before: list rows received a ruler rule, so the item and the drawer both worked. After: the item is shown from the promRule ability (AlertRuleMenu.tsx:96, useAbilities.ts:323), but the drawer renders only from `rule`, which is undefined on list rows.
contracts.visible_effect: The menu item appears; clicking it shows nothing.
contracts.failure_mode: Silent no-op: showSilenceDrawer is set but the drawer never renders.

contracts.action: Delete from a list-row More menu
contracts.before_after: Before: the removed GrafanaRuleLoader passed the ruler rule, so Delete rendered. After: the item needs rulerRule, and list rows pass only promRule.
contracts.visible_effect: Delete is absent from the list-row menu even when canDelete is true.
contracts.failure_mode: Silent omission of a destructive action; no error is shown.

contracts.action: Pause or Resume from a list-row More menu
contracts.before_after: Before: the item rendered from the ruler rule and refreshed rules via onPauseChange. After: the item is gated on rulerRule, and the V2 component passes no onPauseChange.
contracts.visible_effect: No Pause or Resume item in list rows.

contracts.action: Edit button on a Grafana list row
contracts.before_after: Before: Update was gated on the ruler rule's ability. After: it is gated on the promRule's Grafana ability, which reads the folder's accessControl metadata. The edit URL is /alerting/<uid>/edit.
contracts.visible_effect: The Edit link appears when the folder grants update.
contracts.failure_mode: If the folder has not loaded or fails to load, isEditable is false and Edit is hidden. That is silent but matches the pre-PR behaviour for an unloaded folder.

contracts.action: Open a Grafana rule from a list row (view link)
contracts.before_after: Before: the link carried returnTo. After: it does not, so the viewer's back target falls back to /alerting/list.
contracts.visible_effect: Back from the viewer lands on the unfiltered list instead of the list the user came from.

contracts.action: Federation check on the CombinedRule ability path (useAlertRuleAbility Update, Delete, Pause)
contracts.before_after: Before: useAllAlertRuleAbilities computed isFederated from rule.group and made the rule immutable. After: the value is hard-coded false, so federated groups become editable when the user has ruler permission.
contracts.visible_effect: Edit (and Delete and Pause) are offered for federated Mimir rule groups in the rules table and the rule viewer.
contracts.failure_mode: Silent: no warning is shown, and FederatedRuleWarning is still displayed alongside the enabled Edit.

contracts.action: Load a Grafana group's rules in the list (GrafanaGroupLoader)
contracts.before_after: Before: the loader waited on both the Prometheus query and the Ruler group query and merged them. After: it renders the Prometheus rules only, with no Creating or Deleting rows. Polling is unchanged at RULE_LIST_POLL_INTERVAL_MS.
contracts.visible_effect: Skeletons while the Prometheus query loads, then one item per Prometheus rule.
contracts.failure_mode: If the Prometheus query fails with no data, the error Alert is shown (lines 53-63). The component has no separate handling for a failing poll. When the user leaves, the subscription ends; on remount no ref or flag survives, so the cache decides what is shown.

contracts.action: Render a Grafana rule item in the filtered list (FilterView)
contracts.before_after: Before: the item was keyed with `key`. After: the key is dropped; the other branches keep it.
contracts.visible_effect: None on screen; React logs a missing-key warning.
contracts.failure_mode: Index-based identity; no effect while the list is append-only.

contracts.action: Provisioned state for a Grafana list row (isProvisionedPromRule)
contracts.before_after: Before: provenance came from the ruler DTO. After: it comes from the Prometheus DTO, which the PR types as optional provenance (unified-alerting-dto.ts:135).
contracts.visible_effect: Provisioned rows hide Edit and Delete in the list.
contracts.failure_mode: If the backend omitted provenance, provisioned rows would show Edit and Delete. The backend does send it.

contracts.action: Duplicate from a list-row More menu
contracts.before_after: Before: the duplicate used the ruler-based identifier. After: it uses the Grafana identifier built from the prom uid, which RedirectToCloneRule turns into a copyFrom query.
contracts.visible_effect: Navigates to the new-rule page pre-filled from the source rule.
contracts.failure_mode: No failure path in the code read; the redirect is a plain Navigate.

contracts.action: Stop prefetching the ruler group when the Grafana groups are cached
contracts.before_after: Before: the generator dispatched alertRuleApi.util.prefetch for getGrafanaRulerGroup before caching each group. After: the prefetch is gone and only the Prometheus cache write remains.
contracts.visible_effect: None: no component in the unified alerting app now reads the ruler group cache.
contracts.failure_mode: None found. The getGrafanaRulerGroup endpoint (alertRuleApi.ts:271) has no remaining caller in the unified app; that is out of this part and not reported as a finding.

summary: No blockers. Four regressions need fixing in this PR, all in the Grafana list-row path. In the list view, the More menu loses Delete and Pause, Silence shows but does nothing when clicked, and the view link drops returnTo, so Back goes to the unfiltered list. The deprecated CombinedRule ability path also drops its federated-group check, so Edit, Delete and Pause are enabled for federated Mimir groups. The remaining findings are a missing React key, a test that locks in the missing menu items, a RulesTable test gap, and stale comments. Two items are outside this part and not reported as findings: the ruler-group endpoint in alertRuleApi.ts:271 now has no caller, and the PR body is one unrelated line ('Notification Rule Processing Engine') that does not describe the change. Not verified: I could not run tsc or the tests, so type compatibility rests on reading. I read the DTO hunk and grafana.json by diff plus targeted search, not in full. I did not read SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer's props."}
